summary: Iteration 22 retest of the plan editor and upgrade-prompt fixes. Backend: the new test_iter22_plan_robustness.py passed 6/6. A scheduled rename leaves GET /admin/plans name, the public /plans name and db.plans.name on the live name until effective_at, then they switch. No plans document has current_version. The one_draft_per_plan and one_pricing_draft unique partial indexes exist. Five concurrent first-save races each for plans and pricing gave 200+409 or 200+200 (the second save updated the same draft), and there was always exactly one draft. Regression (iter21, iter16, iter19 admin_ops, iter19 concurrency): 52 passed, 1 skipped. UI: the publish bar has no datetime-local input. An empty date shows 'Publish now' with the time input disabled. 'Today' enables the time. 00:00 shows -past and disables 'Schedule'. A time ~2 min ahead enables 'Schedule'. Scheduling AI v22 (identical values) showed admin-plan-ai-scheduled while the header stayed 'PersonalOS AI v21 · live', then v22 went live. The history line reads 'Past live versions:' with 5 entries plus '+16 older' and no scheduled versions (pricing: 5 plus '+8 older'). The pricing draft table shows an amber dot and amber values with '(was 1)' / '(was 600)' only on changed rows, and discard works. Settings credits card: 'View plans' is one line (14px high) and the copy has no hardcoded costs. Two DatePicker popover bugs were found (below). Final state: Basic v1, AI v22, AI Pro v1, all with the original values; pricing v13 equals v1; there are no drafts or scheduled versions.

minor.issue: update_one filters only by {plan_id, version}, not status='draft'. If the draft is published between the find_one and the update_one, the save overwrites a published version. The pricing path already filters status='draft'. Add status:'draft' to the filter and return 409 if matched_count == 0.

ui_bugs.component: DatePicker popover (components/ui/date-picker.tsx + popover.tsx), used by PublishBar
ui_bugs.issue: The calendar popover is squashed to about 86px wide in the publish bar (151px on /styleguide). The 7 day columns overlap and can't be read, so a specific date can't be picked reliably. Only the 'Today' button is usable. RCA: the Popover panel has no width. It shrinks to the max-content of MonthCalendar ('w-full' with fr columns), then Popover freezes that measured width via style.width = rect.width. Fix: give the panel or calendar a fixed width (e.g. className='w-72' on Popover or MonthCalendar), or don't set width when matchWidth is false.

If the Reason field holds text longer than the field (common, since the field is narrow), clicking the date trigger opens the popover and closes it at once. RCA: on blur the input resets its horizontal scroll and fires a 'scroll' event. Popover's capture-phase window scroll listener calls onClose for any scroll outside the panel. Reproduced: with a long reason aria-expanded=false, with a short reason it is true. Fix: in Popover onScroll, only close when the scrolled target contains the anchor (or is the document), e.g. `if (!(target === document || (target instanceof Node && target.contains(anchor)))) return;`.

design_issues.screen: Admin > Plans & Pricing publish bar (3-column card layout)
issues: The grid sm:grid-cols-[1fr_7rem_1fr] is too tight in a plan card. After a date is picked, the Reason input shrinks to about 30px (it shows 'al'). Put Reason on its own full-width row.
The 7rem time column cuts off the value: '09:00 AM' shows as '09:00 AI' (also in the wide pricing bar), and '12:00 AM' shows as '2:00 AM'. Widen it to about 8.5–9rem.

action_items: Fix the DatePicker popover width (fixed width on the panel or calendar; don't freeze the measured shrink-to-fit width).
Fix Popover scroll-dismiss so scroll events from unrelated inputs (such as a text input resetting scrollLeft on blur) don't close it.
PublishBar layout: put Reason on its own row and widen the time column so 'hh:mm AM' isn't cut off.
Add status:'draft' to the update_one filter in save_plan_draft.
critical_code_review_comments: PublishBar works out 'when > Date.now()' at render time only. If the admin leaves the bar open past the chosen time, Schedule stays enabled until the next render, and the server returns 400 (handled by a toast). This is acceptable but could be re-checked on click.

HistoryLine sorts by version, not effective_at. With an out-of-order schedule (an older scheduled version going live after a newer publish-now), the order and the 'live' meaning can mislead. Edge case.
DatePicker nests a role=button span (Clear) inside a <button>, which is invalid interactive nesting (a11y).
plan_state and pricing_state still duplicate the current/scheduled/draft logic (carried over from iter21).

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all requested flows verified; DatePicker popover unusable for non-today dates and closes after a long reason)

seed_data_creation: Created plan_versions: AI renamed v(n) scheduled 4s ahead then restored, and AI v22 scheduled via the UI with identical original values (now live). Basic and pricing race drafts were discarded. A pricing v14 draft was created and discarded via the UI. Audit rows were written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter22 imports restore_all from test_iter21. To use the publish bar in Playwright, open the date picker before typing a long reason (or keep the reason short) and click 'Today'. The calendar days are squashed until the width fix lands. Use a viewport at least 1500px tall so the 'Today' button doesn't make Playwright scroll, since any scroll closes the popover. The browser TZ is UTC. Final live: Basic v1, AI v22, AI Pro v1 (original values), pricing v13 (=v1), no drafts or scheduled versions.
